landingEyebrow: A calmer place for your credentials
landingTitle: Your passwords, all in one place.
landingBody: A personal vault for the details you need every day, with privacy and clarity at its heart.
landingFootnote: Web vaults are online-only. Unlocked content lives in browser memory and locks automatically.
faqA1: Yes. Sealero is zero-knowledge: your vault is encrypted on your device before it ever leaves it. The server stores ciphertext only and can never read your passwords, notes, or TOTP secrets.
faqQ2: What happens if I forget my master password?
faqA2: Your master password never leaves your device and cannot be recovered by us. Use the 24-word recovery key you backed up at registration to regain access. Without it, the vault cannot be opened.
faqA3: The server is open source (AGPLv3) and free to self-host, with unlimited items and devices. The Pro plan covers the official hosted cloud, so you do not have to run a server yourself.
faqA4: Web is available now, with an Android app in development. Your vault syncs across devices when you use the official cloud or your own server.
faqQ5: Is the server code open source?
faqA5: Yes. The server is published under AGPLv3 on GitHub, so anyone can read, audit, and self-host it. The Android app stays closed source.
pricingSubtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you want the official cloud.
pricingNote: Prices are tentative and may change before launch.
pricingProF2: Hosted sync, no server to run
